# Adobe Community

> > Adobe Community is the official multilingual support and discussion platform for Adobe Creative Cloud products, including Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, Acrobat, Substance 3D, and more.

The community serves users worldwide with dedicated forums in English, Japanese, and Korean, providing product announcements, feature requests, bug reports, and peer-to-peer support across Adobe's entire product ecosystem. Users can ask questions, share work, and connect with other creators and Adobe experts.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Creative Cloud
- Substance 3D Plugins
- Premiere Rush
- After Effects
- Camera Raw
- Adobe Fresco
- Adobe Fonts
- Acrobat Sign
- Adobe Podcast
- Bridge
- Community Forums
- Multilingual Support (Japanese, Korean)
- Feature Requests
- Bug Reports
- Product Announcements

## Product Announcements & Updates

- [Acrobat Sign Announcements](https://community.adobe.com/announcements-34): Acrobat Sign announcements with product releases and updates
- [Acrobat Online Announcements](https://community.adobe.com/announcements-26): Adobe Acrobat Online community announcements forum
- [Adobe Aero Announcements](https://community.adobe.com/announcements-80): Adobe Aero announcements forum (empty category)
- [Adobe Dimension お知らせ (Japanese)](https://community.adobe.com/アドビからのお知らせ-191): Japanese Adobe Dimension announcements (empty category)
- [Photoshop Fix お知らせ (Japanese)](https://community.adobe.com/アドビからのお知らせ-284): Japanese Adobe announcements for Photoshop Fix (empty category)

## Creative Cloud Applications

- [Adobe Fresco Community](https://community.adobe.com/fresco-644): Adobe Fresco community hub for sharing work and connecting users
- [Adobe Fonts Community](https://community.adobe.com/adobe-fonts-433): Global Adobe Fonts user community for announcements and questions
- [Adobe Podcast Community](https://community.adobe.com/adobe-podcast-512): Adobe Podcast community forum for user discussions and support
- [Premiere Rush フォーラム (Japanese)](https://community.adobe.com/premiere-rushフォーラム-302): Japanese Premiere Rush community forum for video editing Q&A
- [After Effects 게시판 (Korean)](https://community.adobe.com/after-effects-게시판-348): Korean After Effects community for questions and discussions
